title: How to Laravel series: Let's talk Gulp
content:
<html><head></head><body>In my last article I explained two ways of implementing Grunt to your Laravel application. Now we are taking a look at the same setup, but we are using Gulp instead of Grunt. Gulp what? Don’t worry, I will show you what Gulp is, how it works and why you probably should consider switching.
            </body></html>
